title: Brand AI-Readiness Audit Report
description: Contract for the single report emitted by the audit-orchestrator entrypoint. The required fields are a superset of the round's minimum shape; the additions carry the reproducibility, dependency and coverage information that makes the report actionable.

site.description: Registrable domain of the audited site, e.g. 'example.com'.

audited_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at which the audit began.

audit_scope.description: What was actually inspected. Without this a reader cannot tell whether a clean report means a clean site or a shallow crawl.

sample_seed.description: Seed used for deterministic page selection. Re-running with the same seed inspects the same pages.

content_patterns_detected.description: Drives which conditional checks apply. See references/content-patterns.md.

stage_scores.description: 0-100 per pipeline stage. Lets a reader see which stage is the bottleneck rather than reading fifty findings.

headline.description: One sentence a non-expert can act on, naming the single highest-leverage fix.

severity_inputs.description: The three quantities severity was derived from. Makes the label auditable.

detected_by.description: Skill id that produced the finding.

evidence.description: Plain-language statement of what was observed, with counts and URLs. Must state an observation, never an inference.

reproduction.description: How a developer confirms this themselves. This is what separates a claim from a proof.

command.description: A single shell command reproducing the observation.

confidence.description: Lower when the check ran degraded, e.g. no headless browser available.

blocked_by.description: Finding ids that make this one moot until they are resolved.

mechanism.description: Why this fix resolves this cause. A fix that cannot state its mechanism is a guess.

verification.description: How to confirm the fix worked, ideally the reproduction command now returning the expected result.

opportunities.description: Improvements where no defect was detected. Required by the round: suggestions may go beyond the problems found.

not_assessed.description: Checks that could not run. Reporting these honestly is what stops absence of evidence being read as evidence of absence.

impact.description: What a reader cannot conclude because this did not run.
